steps.npc: Hey guy! Always nice to see a fresh face!
That's right, guy! Ain't nobody better at fishing round here than me! That's for sure!

options.text: Can I fish here instead of you?

steps.player: Can I fish here instead of you?

steps.npc: Sorry guy! This is my lucky spot!

options.text: Do you have any tips for me?

steps.player: Do you have any tips for me?

steps.npc: Why would I help you? I wanna stay the best! I'm not givin' away my secrets like old Grampa Jack does!
You really have no clue do you! He won this competition four years in a row! He lives in the house just outside the gate.
